output.primary_goal: Let a player clear a grid of hidden cells without detonating any mines, using numeric clues about adjacent mines.
output.scope_summary: A single-player minesweeper game consisting of a mine grid, cell reveal and flag interactions, win/loss detection, and basic scoring such as elapsed time.
model_focus: game board with grid dimensions, mine placement and per-cell state (hidden, revealed, flagged)
adjacent mine counts and cascade reveal of empty regions
game session lifecycle including start, win and loss conditions
difficulty settings controlling grid size and mine count
scoring via elapsed time and remaining flag counter
assumptions: The game is single-player and runs locally without a server.
Standard classic minesweeper rules apply, including a safe first click.
Preset difficulty levels (e.g., beginner, intermediate, expert) are sufficient.
